name: Crash Dumps and Error Reports
description: Snapshots Windows and applications write when something crashes. Useful to a developer for a few days, then dead weight.

rules.reason: A crash dump written when a program stopped working. Nothing reads it unless you are debugging that crash.
A Windows Error Reporting record for a crash over a week old. It has already been sent or abandoned.
A memory dump left in your temp folder over a week ago. These are often large, and they are only useful to whoever was diagnosing that crash.
